description: As a traveller, I want my next trips on the home screen, so I can see what’s coming without searching.
Show up to three upcoming trips as cards, soonest first, each with its place, dates and a picture. With no trips, show the empty state from KW-137.

checklist.label: Screen reader reads place, then dates

comments.name: Jonas Lind
comments.text: The design has three cards; should a fourth trip show a “See all” link?

comments.name: Ama Mensah
comments.text: Yes, I’ll add it under the cards. It goes to the trips list.
